name: Social Proof Finder
description: Weekly social-proof scout, as an Attention agent-builder flow: schedule -> askAttention (scan the week's calls for testimonials and success quotes, write the report) -> post to a channel. The @activepieces/piece-schedule cron trigger is verified against Activepieces. Confirm the askAttention context scope for a non-conversation query (contextType 'user') and the output action against your own export. Set connections and the placeholder ids (<...>) on import.

nextAction.name: find_social_proof
nextAction.displayName: Scan the week's calls for social proof, write the report

input.prompt: You are the Social Proof Finder agent. Scan all customer-facing calls from the last 7 days for the best social proof material. Flag moments of genuine customer satisfaction, success, or positive outcomes ('we have seen great results', 'our team loves it', or a specific metric the customer attributes to the product). PRIORITIZE quotes that are specific, authentic, and mention a measurable result. AVOID false positives: routine politeness ('thanks for your help'), neutral status talk, or anything lukewarm does NOT count. If there were no calls, output exactly: 'Social Proof Finder ran for this period. No customer calls recorded this week, so no social proof to report.' and stop. If there were calls but no genuine social proof, say so plainly. Otherwise, group results by account and lead with a one-line header (how many stories found). For each story output: 'Call Title: ...' then 'Summary: ...' then 'Quote: "<verbatim customer quote>"' then 'Account / Speaker: <account> - <name, title>' then 'View Call: <link>'. Sort the strongest, results-backed quotes first. Note clearly that quotes are unverified draft material and must be approved by the customer before any public use. Apply these humanizer rules: no em dashes, no AI throat-clearing, no hype adjectives, one clear ask.

nextAction.name: post_report
nextAction.displayName: Post the social-proof report to the team channel

input.text:
:speech_balloon: *Social Proof Finder -- weekly success stories* (draft, get customer approval before public use)

{{find_social_proof.output}}
